responsibility: Implements the CRIS backend’s C-side target logic that complements cris.md and cris.h. This file defines the target hooks, per-function machine state, and helper routines that govern CRIS calling convention details, varargs setup, function return/value handling, frame layout and frame-pointer requirements, trampoline generation for nested functions, register and mode validity, reload and move costs, address and RTX costing, asm operand/address printing, inline-asm clobber adjustment, option overriding, file start/libfunc initialization, object/constant alignment policy, and the CRIS-specific post-delay-slot compare-elimination pass hookup, thereby bridging generic GCC RTL expansion/final emission with CRIS-specific ABI, assembly syntax, and optimization behavior.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the same-stem CRIS header, machine description, and option table, this file contains the executable C backend logic and target-hook implementations for the port: it computes ABI/frame/varargs behavior, costs, asm printing, trampoline setup, option finalization, and pass hookups that use definitions from cris.h, cooperate with patterns in cris.md, and act on options declared in cris.opt.
